status: Local comparison passed; production tracking unchanged.
findings: The original collector parsed URL query parameters but ignored multipart POST bodies used by Meta for automatic events. Those requests could appear unnamed.

The prior snapshot with only PageView did not establish a failed fbq bridge: it lacked post-click instrumentation. Missing explicit query events from that snapshot cannot be attributed to the multipart parser alone.
With click diagnostics and a corrected collector, both normal (non-debug) worker and main-thread runs deliver matching events. No Meta SDK modification or bot-detection bypass was needed.
Repeated the Upskill worker test with periodic worker diagnostics removed; parity still passed.
changes: Added collector support for multipart/form-data and application/x-www-form-urlencoded bodies, with body fields overriding query fields.
Added four collector regression tests, including unrecognized payload rejection.
Saved a reproducible loopback-only fixture using the actual shared FastSpring store, the installed Partytown runtime, and real public Meta Pixel configurations.

verification.browser: Existing visible in-app browser tab, with normal browser settings; interactions via UI controls. Earlier user-operated tests retained as historical evidence.
events: explicit Lead and Purchase with eventID
inferred Lead where present in the main-thread control
verification.matching: Upskill sends matching data in both modes. Planet does not in either mode; configuration differences preserved.
verification.sdk: Real Meta SDK with local request interception, not a mocked fbq implementation.
verification.purchase: Simulated FastSpring callback through real shared handler; no actual order or payment.
verification.tests: 4 parser regression tests passed; exact normalized event/payload parity assertions passed for Upskill (11 events) and Planet (10 events).

limitations: This verifies outgoing payloads, not Meta reporting, attribution, or production-domain Event Setup Tool rules.
Other three Facebook-enabled sites have not been retested with this fixture.
No live-site rollout or performance improvement is claimed.

commands.controls: For each mode and pixel, click FastSpring checkout start, FastSpring completed purchase, explicit conversions, then Apply now. Compare /status entries by document URL.
commands.isolation: Loopback only; CSP blocks unhandled external collection; collection requests are captured locally. Do not deploy this test harness.

liveChanges: None; Facebook remains on the main thread, with GA, HubSpot and Chatwoot unchanged.
